overview.text: Appointed in 2021 and elected in 2022, Lake County Regional Superintendent of Schools Michael Karner secured $18 million in grants. He previously served as a Regional Safe School Program principal and taught math, Spanish and ELL. After the Illinois Virtual School shut down in 2021, he secured grants to relaunch it. He says over 25,000 people have used ReferralGPS, a mental health service his office implemented.
